decision_explanation: A fixed turnover relationship is visible in part of the pre-registered diagnostic, but complete conditioned, strata and sensitivity coherence is not established.

features.quintile_method: stable ascending rank by feature, symbol, signal_date, original row index
features.relative_volume: volume_T / mean(volume[T-20:T-1]) using raw frozen daily_k volume

comparison_baseline.definition: the same qualified pair-complete cohort excluding the fixed joint intersection; outcome availability does not define membership
comparison_baseline.name: qualified_pair_complete_non_joint

joint_intersection.eligible_definition: qualified in-scope cohort; each feature's top 1% is selected independently from its non-null rows using the existing stable-ranked definition; joint eligible rows require both feature values and the intersection is the exact membership intersection
